title: PAD 02 — CENTRE AT FRAME CORNER, 56% OF PAD VISIBLE
bug: Old path: centre-in-frame plus any visible probe was enough. The pad is clipped by two edges, only 55.7% visible, and it still emits a centre heat cell.
fix: A pad centre now needs at least 60% of the projected pad visible. This frame keeps presence=1, drops the centre, masks the visible footprint, and R013 sends it to review.

after.rule_error: R013: pad is only 56% visible; need at least 60% of the pad pattern
